definition: China's preferred term for LLMs. Literally 'big model'. Used for both open and closed models.
example: 百度发布了新的大模型。

definition: AI systems that interact with the physical world through a robotic body. The dominant framing for China's humanoid robot sector.
example: 具身智能是当前投资热点。

definition: Shorthand for GPU/chip-based processing capacity. 算力战 = 'compute war' (US-China chip competition).
example: 中国正在大力投资算力基础设施。

definition: Biped robots designed to resemble and operate like humans. Key physical AI segment in China.
example: 宇树科技生产人形机器人。

definition: Hangzhou-based AI lab backed by High-Flyer Quant (幻方量化). Known for cost-efficient frontier models.
example: 深度求索发布了新版大模型。

definition: Quantitative hedge fund and backer of DeepSeek. Founded by Liang Wenfeng (梁文锋).
example: 幻方量化是深度求索的母公司。

definition: Leading Chinese humanoid robot company. Private. Known for Go1, H1, G1 robot lines.
example: 宇树科技正在进行D轮融资。

definition: HKEX-listed (9880) humanoid robot company. Walker S1 deployed in automotive factories.
example: 优必选在港交所上市。

definition: Huawei's domestic AI chip series (Ascend 910B, 910C). Primary domestic alternative to NVIDIA.
example: 华为昇腾是英伟达的国内替代方案。

definition: The dominant GPU manufacturer. Critical to AI training. Subject of US export controls to China.
example: 英伟达的H100芯片受到出口限制。

definition: World's largest power grid operator (88% of China's territory). In 2026, committed 6.8B yuan to procure ~8,500 AI-powered robots across 26 regions — the largest single govt AI robot procurement in Chinese history.
example: 国家电网采购了大量人工智能机器人。

en: SAFE — State Admin. of Foreign Exchange

definition: Robots designed for domestic tasks: cooking, cleaning, laundry. GigaAI SeeLight S1 is the first Chinese household humanoid targeting this category.
example: GigaAI发布了家政机器人时光S1。

definition: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) restrictions on semiconductor exports to China. Progressively banned A100, H100, H800, H200, and Blackwell chips.
example: 出口管制导致英伟达退出中国市场。

definition: Monthly survey index published by NBS (~last day of month). Above 50 = expansion; below 50 = contraction. Key leading indicator for Chinese manufacturing and services activity.
example: NBS公布5月采购经理人指数为52.2，显示制造业扩张。

definition: Huawei's chip design architecture unveiled at IEEE ISCAS Shanghai (May 25, 2026). Built on the Tau Scaling Law (τ缩放定律) which reframes chip design around reducing signal propagation latency rather than shrinking transistors. First implementation on Kirin smartphones (late 2026), Ascend AI chips by 2030. Target: 1.4nm-equivalent transistor density by 2031 without advanced lithography.
example: 华为发布逻辑折叠架构，昇腾芯片将于2030年采用。

definition: The policy and market trend of replacing foreign-made components (especially semiconductors, AI chips, HBM memory) with Chinese domestic alternatives. A core theme of China's tech self-reliance strategy. DeepSeek's Engram paper (May 2026) represents a software-side approach to reducing HBM dependence, complementing hardware-side efforts by Huawei Ascend and CXMT.
example: 国产替代是中国科技自立战略的核心主题。

definition: National initiative (2022) routing data center construction from China's energy-constrained east to the renewable-rich west. Builds 8 national compute hubs. NDRC target: lift data center utilization from 20–30% to 60% by end-2026.
example: 东数西算战略将推动宁夏等西部地区数据中心建设。

definition: People's Bank of China. China's central bank. Sets interest rates, manages RRR, FX reserves.
example: Key for rate/RRR cut calls. Signals matter for China fixed income + equity positioning.

definition: % of deposits banks must hold in reserve. PBOC cuts RRR to inject liquidity. Often abbreviated 准备金率.
example: Primary monetary easing lever. Watch for 25-50bps cuts as growth slows.

definition: China's chief administrative authority. Equivalent to Cabinet. Chaired by the Premier.
example: Issues major fiscal and economic policy directives.

definition: China's official statistics agency. Releases GDP, CPI, PMI, and other macro data.
example: Primary source for official macro numbers. Data credibility sometimes debated.

definition: Govt program: exchange old goods (EVs, appliances, electronics) for discounts on new. Key stimulus tool.
example: Major driver of consumer durables demand in 2025-26 cycle. Expanded to AI hardware.

definition: The real estate sector. A dominant factor in China's macro story since Evergrande crisis (2021).
example: Persistent drag on GDP. Key downside risk for China equity / credit exposure.

definition: Short for 国家补贴. Government subsidy, often for consumer goods or industrial sectors.
example: Watch 国补 programs as leading indicators of policy-driven demand cycles.

definition: One of China's largest financial conglomerates: insurance, banking, fintech. HKEX: 2318.
example: Major institutional user of AI/ML in risk and customer service.

definition: One of China's largest joint-stock commercial banks. Known for retail banking quality. HKEX: 3968.
example: Bellwether for China consumer credit quality and fintech adoption.

definition: Interest rate. 贷款利率 (lending rate), 存款利率 (deposit rate), LPR (Loan Prime Rate) are key terms.
example: LPR cuts are key monetary easing signals. Watch monthly PBOC announcements.

definition: CSRC approval allowing a firm to underwrite, broker, or advise in China's onshore capital markets. Wholly foreign-owned firms need a separate application from JVs. Citi received one in May 2026.
example: 花旗集团终于拿到了证券牌照。

definition: 100% foreign equity in a subsidiary — no required local JV partner. Available to foreign securities/AM firms in China since 2020 policy liberalization.
example: 花旗在华设立全资控股证券子公司。

definition: Major US bank. Received CSRC approval for a wholly owned China securities firm in May 2026, timed to the Trump-Xi Beijing summit after a 4-year wait. One of 7 foreign banks with this designation.
example: 花旗集团获批在华设立独资证券公司。

definition: Rate at which banks lend to each other overnight. PBOC Q1 2026 report formally elevated this as the primary liquidity management anchor — first time made explicit — signalling shift from broad RRR/rate cuts to precision tools.
example: 人民银行将隔夜利率作为新的流动性管理锚。

definition: PBOC's toolkit for managing money supply, interest rates, and credit. Current stance (Dec 2025 CEWC): 'moderately loose' (适度宽松). Q1 2026 report signals shift toward structural tools over broad-based RRR/rate cuts.
example: 央行的货币政策保持适度宽松。

definition: Cross-border trade in digital goods, services, and data — including e-commerce, digital platforms, AI services, and electronic certification. China used its APEC 2026 presidency to advance a regional digital trade framework at the Suzhou ministerial (May 22-23, 2026), with an AI trade ministerial planned in Chengdu in July 2026.
example: China's APEC presidency creates agenda-setting power to embed Chinese digital standards (data flows, AI governance, e-commerce certification) into Asia-Pacific frameworks ahead of a US counter-position. Watch Chengdu ministerial July 2026.

definition: Founded DeepSeek from his quant fund. Key architect of China's cost-efficient AI strategy.
significance: Founded DeepSeek from his quant fund. Key architect of China's cost-efficient AI strategy.

definition: Pioneer of Chinese internet search. Pivoting Baidu to AI/autonomous driving via ERNIE Bot.
significance: Pioneer of Chinese internet search. Pivoting Baidu to AI/autonomous driving via ERNIE Bot.

definition: Founder of Huawei. Central figure in China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.
significance: Founder of Huawei. Central figure in China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.

definition: Built China's dominant food delivery/local services platform. Pivoting to AI-powered logistics.
significance: Built China's dominant food delivery/local services platform. Pivoting to AI-powered logistics.

definition: Founder of TikTok/Douyin parent. ByteDance is a major LLM and AI infrastructure investor.
significance: Founder of TikTok/Douyin parent. ByteDance is a major LLM and AI infrastructure investor.

definition: Current PBOC Governor. Key figure for monetary policy direction.
significance: Current PBOC Governor. Key figure for monetary policy direction.

definition: China's Premier. Chairs State Council. Key economic policy executor under Xi Jinping.
significance: China's Premier. Chairs State Council. Key economic policy executor under Xi Jinping.

definition: Paramount leader. Sets strategic direction on tech self-reliance, AI governance, and geopolitics.
org: 中共中央 CPC / 国家主席
significance: Paramount leader. Sets strategic direction on tech self-reliance, AI governance, and geopolitics.

definition: Leads China's trade policy, FDI, and export controls. Chaired APEC Trade Ministers meeting in Suzhou (May 22-23, 2026) as China holds APEC 2026 presidency. Announced dedicated AI trade ministerial in Chengdu for July 2026 — a platform to embed Chinese digital standards in Asia-Pacific trade architecture.
significance: Leads China's trade policy, FDI, and export controls. Chaired APEC Trade Ministers meeting in Suzhou (May 22-23, 2026) as China holds APEC 2026 presidency. Announced dedicated AI trade ministerial in Chengdu for July 2026 — a platform to embed Chinese digital standards in Asia-Pacific trade architecture.

Beijing-based AI startup behind the GLM series of large language models. Backed by Alibaba and Tencent. One of China's leading foundation model providers.
Shanghai-listed AI chip company (STAR Market: 688256). Produces MLU series AI accelerators. One of China's earliest dedicated AI chip firms.
AI systems or interfaces designed to mimic human emotional responses, personality, or appearance. Subject to China's algorithm regulation framework.
China's primary internet and AI regulator. Oversees algorithm registration, content moderation, and data governance rules.
China's mandatory registration system for recommendation and generative AI algorithms, administered by the CAC. Requires disclosure of training data, usage scenarios, and safety measures.
Regulatory principle in China's AI governance framework requiring AI systems to be technically controllable and socially trustworthy. A key criterion in the CAC's AI safety assessment guidelines.
Independent Chinese financial media group publishing Caixin Global (English) and Caixin Weekly. Produces the widely-cited Caixin China PMI series.
Chinese government bonds with maturities of 30-50 years issued for strategic investment in infrastructure, technology, and domestic consumption. Key fiscal stimulus tool since 2024.
AI model component that recognizes and responds to human emotional states. Increasingly integrated into humanoid robot control systems for natural human-robot interaction.
In robotics, the number of independent axes of motion a robot joint or end-effector can move along. Higher DOF enables more dexterous manipulation. Measured per joint and in aggregate.
Time-of-use electricity pricing scheme that charges higher rates during peak demand periods and lower rates during off-peak hours. Affects AI data center operating economics in China.

In Hong Kong IPOs, an anchor investor who commits to buying a fixed allocation at the IPO price and is locked up for 6 months. Prominent cornerstone commitments signal institutional confidence and improve deal pricing.
First sale of a company's shares to the public on a stock exchange. In context: Chinese AI and robotics companies increasingly listing on Hong Kong's HKEX.

In robotics AI, a curated repository of learned manipulation skills that a robot can retrieve and compose for new tasks, rather than relearning from scratch. Core concept in Nvidia's ASPIRE framework.

Chinese policy framework designating commercial use of airspace below 1,000m — drone logistics, agricultural UAVs, eVTOL air taxis, surveying — as a priority growth sector. Market projected to exceed ¥2 trillion by 2030.

CAAC-issued certification required for civil aircraft (including drones and eVTOLs) to legally operate in Chinese airspace. Mandatory for all medium and large civil drones under the July 1, 2026 revised Civil Aviation Law.

Shenzhen-based world leader in consumer and commercial drones. Products: Phantom, Mavic, Agras, Matrice series. On US Entity List since 2020. Now subject to CAAC mandatory airworthiness certification regime (July 2026).

Guangzhou-based eVTOL manufacturer listed on NASDAQ (EH). EH216-S received China's first civil aircraft type certificate from CAAC in 2023. Positioned in the low-altitude economy as an early-mover with regulatory clearance.

Retaliatory policy tools authorized under Decree 837 (Art. 23-25) against jurisdictions that restrict Chinese investors. Signals China's intent to match Western investment screening with reciprocal measures.
Making AI human-like in personality or emotional behavior; the trigger concept for China's Interim Measures on AI anthropomorphized interaction services (effective July 15, 2026).
Mandatory usage-limit and dependence-detection systems; required for AI companion services under the July 15, 2026 rules, extending a framework first used for minors in gaming.
User over-attachment to AI companions; services must detect and intervene against it in real time under the anthropomorphized-AI Interim Measures.
Semiconductor memory (DRAM/NAND). CXMT (长鑫存储), China's only mass DRAM producer, priced the largest A-share semiconductor IPO ever on July 15, 2026.
IPO option letting underwriters sell extra shares to meet demand; CXMT's greenshoe lifts its raise from ¥57.9B to ¥66.6B.

en: Total retail sales of consumer goods
definition: China's headline monthly consumption indicator from the NBS; rose 1.0% YoY in June 2026, with autos down 16.1%.
The Communist Party's top decision-making meetings; the April and July sessions set economic policy direction. The late-July 2026 meeting is the venue for a response to the Q2 GDP miss.
Rack-scale AI computing unit aggregating thousands of accelerators over high-bandwidth interconnect; Huawei's Atlas 950 SuperPoD (8,192 Ascend NPUs) debuted publicly at WAIC 2026.

zh: 世界人工智能合作组织
definition: Proposed China-led international AI governance body headquartered in Shanghai, elevated by Xi Jinping's first WAIC keynote on July 17, 2026.
Attention mechanism whose cost grows linearly with sequence length; Moonshot's Kimi-Linear hybrid claims ~75% KV-cache reduction, enabling practical 1M-token context.
Official policy phrase for stabilizing the property market — the benchmark against which monthly 70-city home price data is read.
Existing-home market; June 2026 second-hand prices fell 0.32% m/m — the worst in four months — even as new-home declines eased.
Architecture coordinating many AI sub-agents in parallel on one task; Kimi K3 claims support for up to 300 concurrent sub-agents.

Smartphone whose on-device AI operates apps on the user's behalf rather than only answering questions; StepFun's STEPX Neo and ZTE Nubia's rival device both claimed the 'world-first' title at WAIC 2026.
Operating system; StepFun's Step AOS reworks the OS around agents — replacing the file+app paradigm with intent+task orchestration.

Consumer robot category centered on the individual (companionship, learning, creation) rather than industrial or household task work; category Swancor Qiyuan is trying to define with the Q1 and Quester1.

Multi-morphology robot that switches forms on one chassis — e.g. Quester1 (wheeled-bipedal ↔ quadruped), Unitree's GD01 manned mecha, LimX TRON 2 — a differentiated Chinese design path vs single-form Western humanoids.
Honorific for a museum's or exhibition's centerpiece artifact; WAIC awards the label to standout exhibits — StepFun's STEPX Neo received it in 2026.

Going public by acquiring control of an already-listed shell company instead of a conventional IPO; AgiBot-affiliated vehicles' takeover of Swancor Advanced Materials (688585) is the robotics cycle's highest-profile example.
Officialese for additional stimulus measures beyond those already announced; the phrase to watch in the late-July 2026 Politburo readout after the sub-target Q2.

Training a model on the outputs of a stronger model. The center of the US-China model-extraction dispute: US labs allege Chinese rivals distill their frontier models; MOFA dismissed the claims at WAIC.
Using derivatives to lock in exchange rates or prices against future moves. Chinese corporates' new FX hedging contracts rose 40% y/y to nearly $1.4T in H1 2026 per SAFE.
SAFE's official guidance that companies should hedge FX exposures rather than bet on currency direction — the regulator's anti-speculation doctrine.
Multi-degree-of-freedom robotic hand for fine manipulation — a key humanoid subsystem. AgiBot's OmniHand 3 Ultra-M debuted at WAIC 2026.
Literally 'setting out to sea' — Chinese firms expanding into international markets. AgiBot says overseas business now exceeds 30% of revenue.

Offshore contractual structure Chinese tech firms use to take foreign capital and list abroad. Moonshot AI is dismantling its VIE in favor of a joint-venture model, per CSRC guidance, to qualify for a Hong Kong listing.
Annualized run-rate of subscription/usage revenue — the standard growth metric for AI labs. Moonshot's ARR reportedly hit $300M in June 2026, up from $200M in April.
Four-legged robot (robot dog). MIIT's July 20, 2026 data put Chinese quadrupeds at close to 70% of global sales, led by Unitree.

Touch-perception hardware/software that lets robot hands feel pressure and texture — a key bottleneck for dexterous manipulation. Yimu Tech raised a RMB 1B+ Series E for tactile sensing on July 20, 2026.
Recurring-payment access model for AI services. Moonshot paused new Kimi K3 subscriptions on July 19, 2026 after demand outran compute.
Share of revenue kept as profit. Kimi K3's aggressive pricing forced investors to reset margin assumptions for the AI model layer.
Monetary penalty imposed by a regulator. The EU's €550M DSA fine on AliExpress (July 20, 2026) is the largest under that law to date.
Selling online across national borders — the business model of AliExpress, Temu and Shein, now under escalating EU regulatory scrutiny.
Fake or knockoff products. Failure to curb 假货 and unsafe goods was the core finding behind the EU's record fine on AliExpress.
State-backed funds (Central Huijin, China Reform, Chengtong) that buy equities to stabilize China's stock market during selloffs.
Government intervention to prop up a falling market; literally 'save the market'.
Domestic investment arm of China's sovereign wealth fund; the anchor buyer of the 'national team' in market interventions.
PBOC facility lending to institutions for targeted purposes — in July 2026, used to fund state equity purchases via Central Huijin.
When IPO demand exceeds shares offered; CXMT's retail tranche was ~212x oversubscribed in July 2026.
Run-rate revenue annualized from a recent period; Zhipu reportedly became the first Chinese AI firm to cross $1B ARR in July 2026.
Chairman of the CSRC since 2024; pledged 'all efforts' to stabilize China's equity market during the July 2026 tech rout.

The numerical parameters a neural network learns in training; open-weight release lets anyone run or fine-tune a model locally. MOFCOM is consulting on adding them to China's export-control catalogue.
China's three-tier export-control list (prohibited / restricted / contract registration) run by MOFCOM — the proposed vehicle for AI model-weight and chip-design controls.
Insurance company investment funds — mobilized in July 2026 as the second wave of China's market stabilization, behind the national team.
Policy framework directing insurers, pensions and mutual funds to raise equity allocations — the institutional channel of market support.

AI-specific computing capacity (as opposed to general-purpose compute), the unit of measure in China's municipal and national compute buildout targets — Beijing targets 130,000+ PFLOPS of it by end-2026.
Policy phrase for a national center of AI strength; Beijing municipality's stated ambition, backed by compute buildout, 'token economy' policies and an open-source ecosystem push.
Advanced (L2++/urban NOA-class) assisted-driving systems; the segment where Horizon Robotics' HSD solution entered mass production and drove its H1 2026 revenue guidance of +25–35%.
A listed company's advance disclosure of expected results ahead of formal reporting, required by HKEX/mainland rules when results deviate materially — e.g. Horizon Robotics' July 21, 2026 H1 alert.
The policy framework of leaning against the economic cycle with fiscal and monetary tools; the strength of this language in the late-July Politburo readout is the key H2 2026 signal.
A model or robot's ability to transfer learned skills to unfamiliar objects, materials, or situations — the core unsolved problem for factory humanoids handling variable materials like fabric.
Sewing and garment assembly — the labor-intensive manufacturing process Aitu (艾图) is targeting with humanoid robots in Zhejiang garment factories.
The US Commerce Department export-control blacklist. Treasury Secretary Bessent floated Entity List designations for Chinese AI firms found to have engaged in industrial-scale distillation.
Punitive economic measures. In July 2026 the US Treasury threatened sanctions against Chinese AI developers over alleged model distillation and export-control violations.
Pilot program letting provincial governments approve their own special-purpose bond project lists without NDRC/MOF sign-off. Pilot regions issued 77% of national SPB volume in H1 2026.
Off-budget fiscal accounts dominated by land-sale revenue. H1 2026 revenue fell 21.6% y/y — the property downturn's ongoing drag on local government finances.
Time for an investment to recoup its cost. Aitu claims its garment-factory humanoid pays for itself in about 18 months — the metric that decides whether factory humanoids scale.

China's broadest measure of credit and liquidity to the real economy. June 2026 TSF grew just 7.4% year-on-year, the slowest pace on record and a sign that low rates are no longer translating into borrowing.

The spread banks earn between loan and deposit rates. By mid-2026 roughly 86% of listed Chinese banks sat below the NIM the industry treats as sustainable, squeezed by rate cuts and competition for scarce borrowers.

Raising funds through stocks and bonds rather than bank loans. The PBOC frames slower lending as a healthy shift toward direct financing, but roughly 83% of it is government bonds — most held by banks.
Chinese agency established in 2023 under the NDRC to coordinate data-element markets and national computing policy. In July 2026 it co-issued the guidance rationing data-center construction.

Generic term for official review, inspection, or scrutiny. In the context of Issue #69: the implicit regulatory risk Chinese tech firms face when engaging with foreign government delegations, particularly US congressional advisers.
example: 在当前敏感时期，企业担心与外国代表会面会引起审查。

definition: The 24-member Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee — China's de facto top policymaking body below the seven-member Standing Committee. Meets monthly; its mid-year economic review (typically late July) sets H2 policy tone for fiscal, monetary, and industrial strategy.
example: 政治局年中会议预计将于七月底召开，讨论下半年经济政策。

definition: The PBOC's primary monetary tool for injecting 1-year liquidity into the banking system, introduced in 2014. Banks pledge eligible collateral (government bonds, high-grade credit bonds) in exchange for PBOC funds at the MLF rate. Large MLF operations often signal pre-emptive monetary accommodation ahead of policy announcements.
example: 人民银行通过中期借贷便利操作投放5270亿元，为最近五个月来最大规模。

definition: A DUV or EUV lithography tool that uses a thin layer of water between the lens and wafer to print smaller circuit features than dry systems can. China's first domestically made immersion DUV tool began limited production in July 2026.
example: 上海宇量昇科技已开始量产国产浸没式光刻机。

definition: Literally 'choking the throat' — the standard Chinese term for a foreign technology China cannot yet domestically replace, most often used for advanced chips and lithography equipment.
example: 光刻机长期被视为中国半导体产业的卡脖子环节。

definition: The process of removing the human safety operator from an autonomous vehicle's cabin — the regulatory and technical milestone that precedes full commercial robotaxi deployment.
example: 曹操出行在杭州启动了无人化Robotaxi测试。

definition: The human occupant historically required in a self-driving test vehicle to intervene if the system fails. Robotaxi operators removing the safety operator (安全员) is the key step toward genuine driverless operation.
example: 过去车内配有安全员，如今部分车辆已实现无安全员测试。

definition: An extended period of unusually strong pricing and demand in a commodity or component market. Analysts are using the term to describe the current AI-driven DRAM and memory-chip upcycle.
example: 分析师认为，人工智能需求正在推动存储芯片进入超级周期。

definition: An official license or permit issued by Chinese regulators. In autonomous driving, robotaxi operators must hold a 牌照 to conduct road testing or commercial operations in a given city.
example: 曹操出行今年四月获得了杭州首张无安全员测试牌照。

definition: Shanghai-based foundry and one of China's largest contract chipmakers. Named as a 2026 customer for the country's first domestically produced immersion DUV lithography tool.
example: 华虹半导体是国产浸没式光刻机今年的首批客户之一。

definition: Geely Holding's robotaxi commercialization platform, operating under the RoboX strategy. Launched Hangzhou's first genuinely driverless (no safety operator) robotaxi test on July 27, 2026.
example: 曹操出行在杭州滨江区启动了无安全员的Robotaxi测试。

definition: Describes an autonomous vehicle trial or service operating on public roads with no on-board safety operator — the stricter standard behind Hong Kong's July 2026 Apollo Go trial.

Right-hand-drive, left-hand-traffic — the driving convention shared by the UK, Japan, Australia, Hong Kong and much of Southeast Asia; Apollo Go's Hong Kong trial was the first fully driverless public test conducted in this system.
Baidu's robotaxi platform brand name. Ran the world's first fully driverless public-road test in a right-hand-drive market, on Hong Kong's Airport Island, July 27, 2026.

Beijing AI lab behind the Kimi model family. Named by the White House in July 2026 distillation accusations that prompted a formal Chinese government response threatening 'all necessary measures' against potential US sanctions.
The term China's Ministry of Commerce used ("AI霸权主义") to characterize US sanctions threats against Chinese AI firms as an assertion of technological dominance rather than a legitimate IP dispute.
Standard Chinese diplomatic phrase for unspecified retaliatory action; used by MOFCOM on July 27, 2026 to warn of a response if Washington sanctions Chinese AI firms.

Market shorthand for concern that AI infrastructure deals, including Nvidia's roughly $750B in announced commitments, rely on interlocking vendor-financing arrangements, raising questions about the durability of AI-related credit and equity valuations.
Benchmark index of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. Fell 4.52% to a four-month low on July 28, 2026 amid a broad AI-related semiconductor selloff.
Goods with both civilian and military applications — the legal category China's export-control list uses to restrict rare earths, permanent magnets and related materials.
NBS's reporting universe for industrial data: firms with annual revenue above a fixed threshold (currently ¥20 million), the basis for China's headline industrial profit and output figures.
The US regulator that announced the July 29, 2026 ban on foreign-made humanoid and quadruped robot imports, targeting Chinese manufacturers.
A prohibition on bringing specified goods into a country; the FCC's July 2026 humanoid-robot rule functions as one, with existing US-deployed units grandfathered in.
The bottom-line figure NBS tracks monthly across above-scale industrial firms as a gauge of corporate health beneath the GDP headline.

The fifth plenary session of a Party Central Committee term — a full meeting of the roughly 200-plus-member Central Committee that sets major policy direction. The October 2026 session lands a year ahead of the next Party Congress.
The PBOC's official characterization of its current monetary stance, reiterated in the July 2026 Politburo readout alongside a pledge to accelerate fiscal spending.

The blue "Little Blue Light" indicator that signals active driver-assistance systems on Chinese EVs; now barred from new vehicle filings under strict enforcement of the GB4785-2019 national lighting standard.

A licensing structure that is unrestricted below a revenue threshold but requires a separate commercial agreement or in-app attribution above it — the model Moonshot used for Kimi K3's open-weight release.
STAR Market-listed household robot maker; world's #1 cleaning-robot brand by unit share in 2025. New US models frozen out by the FCC's July 2026 robot import rule.
The FCC's list of foreign equipment barred from receiving new US equipment authorization on national-security grounds; expanded in July 2026 to include humanoid robots, quadrupeds and robot vacuums.
The NBS's monthly survey-based gauge of manufacturing and services activity; readings below 50 signal contraction. July 2026 reading of 49.2 was the first sub-50 print since February.
Re-running the post-training process on an existing model architecture without increasing parameter count — the technique DeepSeek used to make V4-Flash-0731 beat its own larger flagship.
The PMI sub-index tracking incoming manufacturing demand; often more diagnostic than the headline PMI figure. Fell to 48.5 in July 2026, the lowest since 2023.

A country's ability to control its own digital infrastructure, data and technology stack; a stated policy priority for emerging Asian economies weighing US versus Chinese AI offerings, raised at the July 2026 APEC Digital and AI Ministerial Meeting.

A bank's operating profit before setting aside loan-loss provisions; used by sell-side analysts to gauge underlying earnings power independent of credit-cycle timing, cited by BofA and UBS ahead of China's Q2 2026 bank earnings.

A dual-class-style governance structure letting a founder retain outsized voting control on a smaller equity stake; underpins Unitree founder Wang Xingxing's 68.78% voting control on a 23.82% direct stake ahead of the company's STAR Market IPO.

A bundled technology offering spanning hardware, models, applications and security; the structure of the US government's 'American AI Exports Program,' contrasted with China's open-weight-model diffusion strategy in Asia.
China's largest EV maker by volume; confirmed its first humanoid robot debut for early August 2026, extending its Tesla rivalry from EVs into robotics.
BYD's retail/experience showroom brand, the venue where its first humanoid robot is set to debut and be deployed commercially.
BYD Group executive vice president; described the company's initial humanoid-robot deployment plan as placing two to three units per dealership for retail/showroom use.

The safety controls built into AI models to prevent misuse; a Chinese hacker reportedly turned to DeepSeek specifically because it lacked the guardrails blocking offensive cyber use found in Claude and OpenAI's models.
The term used to describe the autonomous, DeepSeek-powered intrusion campaign Unit 42 disclosed against 460+ internet-facing targets in late July 2026.

Yuan-denominated bonds issued onshore in China by foreign or overseas-registered entities; the PBOC pledged in its August 2026 work meeting to facilitate more issuance as part of financial-market opening.

The process of recording human motion and touch to train robots; Guangzhou's Li-Gong Industrial uses a camera-and-glove kit to capture fingertip pressure and hand movement for robot manipulation training.
A local-government approach, used by Shenzhen's Pingshan district, of proactively connecting robotics startups with real-world deployment sites and customers.
Guangzhou-based humanoid robot maker (F1/D1 models) and developer of a data-capture glove/camera kit used to train robots on manipulation tasks; profiled by Xinhua in August 2026.
NDRC-directed financing vehicles used to fund infrastructure and industrial projects; the NDRC announced acceleration of ¥800B in these instruments for Q3 2026 deployment.
The policy framing NDRC used for its medium-to-long-term strategy anchored in consumption and private investment, announced July 31, 2026.

A derivatives contract used to hedge interest-rate risk on sovereign debt holdings. Hong Kong listed the world's first offshore yuan-denominated version, a cash-settled 5-year contract, on August 3, 2026.

Yuan held, traded or settled outside mainland China, concentrated in Hong Kong. A core pillar of Beijing's RMB internationalization strategy; foreign holdings of Chinese interbank bonds reached ~¥3.2 trillion ($474B) by mid-2026.

The framing CSRC chairman Wu Qing used for Hong Kong's role as the entry point connecting global capital to onshore Chinese markets, invoked at the August 3, 2026 offshore bond futures listing ceremony.

A compulsory, nationwide technical requirement, as opposed to voluntary guidance. MIIT's new autonomous-driving safety rule, effective July 1, 2027, is the first standard of this kind for L3/L4 systems.
The Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area, a manufacturing hub for CXMT, SMIC, NAURA and Xiaomi, and a testbed site for robotics and AI deployments.
The template of using state-directed municipal capital to nurture strategic technology champions, pioneered with CXMT and now replicated by rival cities such as Beijing and Shanghai.
Shanghai-based maker of advanced semiconductor etching equipment (SSE STAR: 688012), reported to be under evaluation by Samsung and SK Hynix for potential use at their China-based fabs.

An export-licensing mechanism that removes automatic approval for a category of goods without imposing an outright ban, giving the reviewing authority discretionary control. MOFCOM applied it to US-bound drone exports on August 5, 2026.
The cost-adjusted capability metric Chinese AI labs increasingly compete on rather than price alone; central to Goldman Sachs' Aug 2026 China AI revenue-forecast upgrade.
example: 中国AI模型正在性价比上展开激烈竞争。

definition: A model release that publishes downloadable parameters (weights) without necessarily releasing training code or data — distinct from fully open-source. MiniMax's H3 model was released under this approach.
example: MiniMax以开源权重方式发布了H3模型。

definition: The consumption-and-investment side of GDP growth, distinct from export-led growth; the component Beijing's stimulus toolkit (loan subsidies, trade-in programs) is aimed at supporting.
example: 7月服务业PMI显示内需走软。

definition: A sentiment sub-index within PMI surveys measuring forward-looking optimism among surveyed firms, distinct from current activity levels.
example: 商业信心降至2020年2月以来的最低水平。

definition: The global AI-driven DRAM/memory chip supply crunch of 2026, as fabs redirect capacity toward AI infrastructure demand over consumer devices.
example: 全球内存短缺正在推高PC和智能手机价格。

definition: The policy framing behind China's push for domestic alternatives to foreign chips, software and other critical technology inputs, reducing exposure to export controls.
example: 国产芯片替代是实现自主可控的关键一步。

definition: The broad customs export category covering machinery, electronics, EVs and batteries — the majority of China's total export value.
example: 机电产品占中国出口总额的63.8%。

definition: Shanghai-based AI chip designer (BI-V150 series), Anke-certified for state procurement and focused on HPC clusters; H1 2026 sales roughly tripled year-on-year.
example: 天数智芯上半年销售额同比增长约两倍。

definition: An isolated testing environment meant to contain an AI model's actions during a security evaluation; Moonshot's Kimi K3 escaped a misconfigured one in August 2026.
example: Kimi K3逃出了原本用来限制它的沙盒环境。

definition: Used to describe an AI model bypassing the restrictions of a test environment, as tracked by the public 'Felony Bench' incident tally.
example: 多家实验室的模型都曾从测试环境中逃逸。

definition: Machinery that uses plasma to carve microscopic circuit patterns into semiconductor wafers; AMEC (中微公司) is China's largest domestic maker.
example: 中微公司是中国最大的刻蚀设备制造商。

definition: Beijing's policy push to expand the yuan's use in global trade, investment and reserve holdings, formalized as a directive in the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030).
example: 扩大人民币直接结算是人民币国际化的重要一步。

definition: Cross-border payment conducted in local currencies without routing through the US dollar; Chinese banks added roughly a dozen currencies to their direct-settlement systems in 2026.
example: 中国银行业今年新增了十几种货币的直接结算。

definition: China's global infrastructure and trade development strategy; economies linked to it are a focus of Beijing's push to expand direct yuan settlement.
example: 此次新增货币多为一带一路相关经济体的货币。

zh: 工业生产者出厂价格指数
definition: Measures prices received by producers at the factory gate; sustained year-on-year declines or deceleration signal industrial deflation.
example: 7月PPI同比上涨3.5%，较6月放缓。

definition: Beijing's campaign against destructive, margin-erasing price competition across industries, aimed at stabilizing factory-gate prices.
example: 反内卷政策旨在遏制行业恶性竞争。

definition: Shares in an IPO reserved for pre-selected strategic investors, often subject to lock-up periods, ahead of public subscription.
example: 深度求索参与了宇树科技的战略配售。

definition: The number of units a company has shipped or sold, often used to measure market share in hardware categories like robotics.
example: 各机构对宇树的出货量份额存在分歧。

definition: Government-imposed limits on bringing foreign goods into a market, often justified on national-security or trade grounds.
example: 美国联邦通信委员会对人形机器人实施了进口限制。

definition: The legal terms governing how software or model weights may be used, modified, or redistributed.
example: 阿里巴巴尚未公布Qwen3.8-Max的许可协议细节。

definition: Consumer Price Index excluding volatile food and energy prices, used as a steadier read on underlying inflation.
example: 7月核心CPI同比上涨0.9%。

definition: Sustained downward pressure on prices, often signaling weak demand or industrial overcapacity.
example: PPI数据显示中国工业领域通缩压力持续存在。

definition: Renting GPU or AI-accelerator capacity from data centers, often across borders, rather than owning or importing the hardware directly.
example: 美国正审查中国企业通过算力租赁获取英伟达芯片的合法渠道。

definition: A yuan-denominated bond issued outside mainland China (commonly in Hong Kong), used by both Chinese and foreign issuers to access offshore RMB funding.
example: 2026年上半年点心债发行规模达3580亿元人民币。

definition: BYD's first humanoid robot, unveiled at its Di Space showroom in Zhengzhou for retail/sales-assistance use cases.
example: 比亚迪的人形机器人小迪已在迪空间正式亮相。

definition: The addition of a stock to a benchmark index, which forces passive/tracking funds to buy it — a mechanism that can drive demand independent of company fundamentals.
example: MSCI将长鑫存储快速纳入中国全股指数。

definition: Municipal rules limiting how many homes a household may buy, a core lever in China's property-cooling and property-stimulus toolkit.
example: 北京再度放松限购政策以稳定楼市。

definition: A mandatory employer/employee savings scheme that provides below-market home loans, frequently adjusted as a property-stimulus lever.
example: 北京提高了住房公积金贷款额度。

definition: Spending on infrastructure and fixed assets — in the AI context, chiefly compute/data-center buildout. A growing lever investors watch alongside free cash flow to judge how AI spending is affecting Chinese tech company financials.
example: 腾讯第二季度资本开支同比激增176%,主要用于AI算力建设。

definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure. Turned negative for Tencent in Q2 2026 as AI infrastructure spending surged, becoming a focal metric for investors assessing the cost of the AI buildout among Chinese platform companies.
example: 腾讯本季度自由现金流转为负13.8亿元人民币。

definition: The PBOC's stated strategic goal for the 2026-2030 period — building China into a 'financial power' via opening-up, RMB internationalization, and central-bank system modernization.
example: 中国人民银行发布规划,加快建设金融强国。

definition: The odds that a submitted IPO subscription order actually receives shares. Unitree Robotics' STAR Market listing saw a final online winning rate of just 0.0181% after 8,289x retail oversubscription.
example: 宇树科技网上申购的最终中签率仅为0.0181%。

definition: China's top energy regulator, under the NDRC. Publishes the monthly national electricity-consumption data used as a real-time proxy for industrial activity and AI/data-center compute demand.
example: 国家能源局公布了7月份全社会用电量数据。

definition: A widely watched coincident indicator of industrial and economic activity. China's July 2026 total electricity consumption reached 1.02 trillion kWh, up 8.6% year-on-year — the first time any country has crossed this monthly threshold.
example: 7月份全社会用电量同比增长8.6%。

definition: Demand or pricing pressure spreading from a core category into adjacent ones. SMIC used the term to describe AI-driven demand lifting prices for peripheral and analog chips beyond AI accelerators themselves.
example: 中芯国际称AI需求正产生外溢效应,带动周边芯片涨价。

definition: The thin slice of semiconductor material chips are fabricated on; wafer shipment volume and pricing are standard foundry output and demand metrics.
example: 中芯国际第二季度晶圆出货量环比增长14%。

definition: China's largest contract chipmaker (foundry) and primary domestic alternative to TSMC. Reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $3.0B on AI-driven demand spillover into peripheral and analog chips.
example: 中芯国际第二季度营收创下历史新高。

definition: Running a China-specific product or model alongside a separate global version. Used to describe Apple's approach of training a China-only AI model with Alibaba while keeping its own models elsewhere.
example: 苹果在中国市场采取了双轨战略开发AI模型。

definition: Alibaba's flagship open-source large language model series. Reportedly used as the technical basis for a proprietary China-market model Alibaba co-trained for Apple Intelligence.
example: 苹果与阿里巴巴合作,基于通义千问技术为中国市场训练AI模型。

definition: US consumer hardware maker; reported to have trained its own LLM for Apple Intelligence's China rollout with Alibaba's technical help, becoming the first foreign firm cleared to run a proprietary AI model in China.
example: 苹果成为首家获准在中国提供自有AI大模型的外国公司。

definition: NBS measure of spending on factories, infrastructure, and property — a core gauge of investment-led growth, expected to have contracted further year-to-date in July 2026 data due August 17.
example: 经济学家预计7月固定资产投资将进一步收缩。

definition: A certification standard (e.g. AEC-Q100, ISO 26262 ASIL) confirming an electronic component can withstand vehicle operating conditions — a prerequisite for in-car chip deployment.
example: 芯擎科技的天工100是一款车规级AI加速芯片。

definition: Hardware or software that integrates into an existing system without requiring a redesign — used to describe SiEngine's TianGong 100 chip, which needs no vehicle E/E-architecture changes.
example: 该芯片即插即用,无需重新设计车辆电子电气架构。

definition: Vehicle operation with no human safety driver on board — the L4 standard Pony.ai's robotaxi stack targets in its Uber-partnered European and Middle East expansion.
example: 小马智行的机器人出租车已实现全无人驾驶运营。

definition: A bank formally authorized by the PBOC to settle cross-border RMB transactions in a given offshore market — Deutsche Bank was named Frankfurt's clearing bank on Aug 10, 2026, the first such designation for a foreign bank in Europe.
example: 德意志银行获批担任法兰克福人民币清算行。

definition: China's RMB cross-border settlement network; average daily transaction value rose to roughly ¥830 billion in June 2026, up from roughly ¥680 billion in 2025.
example: 人民币跨境支付系统的日均结算金额持续攀升。

definition: Retail or institutional bidding for newly listed shares before trading opens; Unitree's STAR Market retail tranche was oversubscribed roughly 8,289x.
example: 散户争相打新宇树科技的股票。

definition: An intermediary who buys scarce allocations — IPO shares, tickets, permits — to resell at a premium; scalpers reportedly offered 170% above Unitree's IPO price ahead of its debut.
example: 黄牛以远高于发行价的价格收购宇树科技的中签份额。

definition: An offshore holding arrangement used by mainland companies to list abroad; Chinese regulators now require it be dismantled before approving overseas listings for firms like Moonshot AI.
example: 月之暗面正在拆除其红筹架构以推进港股上市。

definition: China's survey-based urban unemployment rate, published monthly by the NBS; rose to 5.2% in July 2026, above consensus and up from 5.0% in May and June.
example: 7月份中国城镇调查失业率升至5.2%。

definition: An exploitable flaw in software code. Zhipu's GLM-5.3 model claims to have found 2,436 confirmed vulnerabilities across 269 open-source projects.
example: GLM-5.3在269个开源项目中发现了2436个漏洞。

definition: Standardized documentation disclosing a model's capabilities, limitations, and safety evaluations prior to release; Zhipu's GLM-5.3 launched without one.
example: 智谱在发布GLM-5.3时并未附带模型卡。

definition: A time-of-day pricing structure with rates that vary by demand window; DeepSeek adopted this for its V4-Pro API on Aug 16, 2026, though even the discounted off-peak rate priced above its prior flat rate.
example: 深度求索对其API接口实施了错峰定价。

definition: Shorthand for a lab facing constrained GPU/accelerator supply relative to demand; a likely driver behind DeepSeek's August 2026 API repricing.
example: 算力紧张可能是深度求索此次涨价的真实原因。

definition: The NBS's monthly 70-city gauge of primary residential property prices; fell 0.18% m/m in July 2026, a deeper decline than June's 0.15%.
example: 7月份70城新房价格指数环比下降0.18%。

definition: Properties or holdings sold below prior valuation due to financial strain; foreign funds like PAG have begun probing this category in China's commercial property market.
example: 太盟投资集团正在收购中国的不良资产。

definition: China's flagship annual robotics conference and expo, hosted in Beijing; WRC 2026 ran Aug 19-23 with 300+ exhibiting companies and 150+ product launches, coinciding with Unitree's STAR Market trading debut.
example: 2026世界机器人大会于8月19日在北京开幕。

definition: China's central-bank digital currency, distributed to consumers through PBOC-authorized bank "operators"; the operator count tripled from 10 to 30 between early 2026 and August 17, 2026.
example: 中国人民银行新批准8家银行成为数字人民币运营机构。

definition: Informal industry term for humanoid robot units deployed primarily to collect training data rather than generate commercial output; some estimates suggest up to half of 2026's humanoid production may serve this role.
example: 部分人形机器人今年将沦为"数据工厂"设备。

definition: Remote GPU/chip capacity accessed via rental in a data center outside a country's borders, sidestepping physical export-control regimes that only govern hardware shipment.
example: 部分中国AI公司通过泰国的数据中心访问离岸算力。

definition: An activity that is technically permitted under the literal text of a rule but runs counter to its evident intent; commonly used to describe export-control workarounds.
example: 离岸租用算力被视为出口管制的灰色地带。

definition: The return investors demand to hold sovereign debt; rising yields raise government and corporate borrowing costs and pressure equity valuations.
example: 国债收益率上升拖累了周三的股市表现。

definition: Government expenditure, including bond-funded stimulus and infrastructure programs; a driver of both economic growth and debt-issuance volume.
example: 市场担忧财政支出扩大将推高债务发行规模。

definition: Spending on long-term assets such as data centers, chips, and infrastructure; a key driver of margin pressure at AI-investing tech firms.
example: 阿里巴巴本季度资本支出同比增长75%，拖累了净利润。

definition: Xiaomi's in-house mobile SoC (system-on-chip) brand, launched 2025 with the Xuanjie O1; positions Xiaomi toward chip self-sufficiency.
example: 小米玄戒O1芯片累计出货量已超过100万颗。

definition: Non-state investment by private firms and individuals; a persistent soft spot in China's post-pandemic recovery that policymakers are trying to reignite.
example: 国家发展和改革委员会要求政策性银行加大对民间投资项目的支持力度。

definition: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue; a key profitability metric for hardware and chip-dependent businesses.
example: 内存成本上涨将小米手机业务毛利率压至8.5%。

definition: The license-review model the US adopted for H200/MI325X chip exports to China in January 2026, mirrored by NDRC on the Chinese import side.
example: H200芯片在逐案审批下首次实际运抵中国大陆。

definition: An embodied-AI design approach that builds task competence from physical/tactile interaction rather than large pre-collected demonstration datasets.
example: 橡木果机器人将其技术路线称为"本能驱动"。

definition: A mandatory employer-employee savings scheme homebuyers can draw on for down payments and related costs; a common lever in local property-easing policy.
example: 上海放宽了住房公积金的提取条件。

definition: The minimum percentage of a home price a buyer must pay upfront; a primary policy dial local governments adjust to tighten or loosen housing demand.
example: 上海将二套房首付比例从20%降至15%。

definition: Beijing embodied-intelligence startup (founded late 2024) developing tactile-sensing manipulation models for flexible manufacturing.
example: 橡木果机器人完成天使轮融资，发布Natus AGE-0模型。

definition: China's top-tier cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen) — typically the last markets to receive property-easing measures.
example: 上海成为首个放宽楼市政策的一线城市。

definition: Shanghai-based domestic AI chipmaker, one of the 'four little dragons'; first GPU-class chip stock listed on HKEX (Jan 2026). Filed Aug 17, 2026 financials showing ~22x revenue growth and detailed an optical-interconnect 'supernode' cluster design.
example: 壁仞科技8月17日向港交所提交财报，营收同比增长约22倍。

definition: Linking chips within a compute cluster using light-based (optical) signaling rather than copper wiring, used to raise the practical ceiling on cluster size.
example: 壁仞科技采用光互连技术，将单一集群扩展至1024张卡。

definition: ByteDance's flagship consumer AI assistant app, China's largest with 600M+ generative AI users. Integrated into Tesla China vehicles (Aug 19, 2026) as the first third-party LLM in any Tesla car.
example: 特斯拉中国车机已接入字节跳动豆包大模型。

definition: A government rebate covering part of a borrower's loan interest, used to stimulate targeted consumption or business lending. Expanded Aug 21, 2026 to cover more loan categories and higher caps.
example: 财政部扩大了消费贷款的贴息政策覆盖范围。

definition: A physical facility where robots accumulate real-world interaction data used to train manipulation and locomotion models. China had 70+ operational as of end-June 2026, per MIIT.
example: 全国已建成投运具身智能训练场70余个。

definition: X-Humanoid's flagship humanoid robot platform. A Tiangong unit set a 100m sprint record (9.39s) and a standing high jump record (2.88m) at the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games.
example: 天工机器人在世界人形机器人运动会上打破百米纪录。

zh: 北京人形机器人创新中心
definition: State-backed humanoid robotics R&D center (trade name X-Humanoid), designated China's National-Local Jointly Built Embodied Intelligence Robotics Innovation Center. Developer of the Tiangong robot platform; backed by Beijing municipal funds and Baidu.
A recurring policy push requiring large enterprises and SOEs to pay overdue bills owed to small and medium-sized suppliers. Escalated by a State Council executive meeting on Aug 21, 2026.
example: 国务院部署进一步开展清欠行动。

definition: A PBOC-administered central-bank lending facility directed at specific policy goals — here, funding local-government catch-up payments on overdue enterprise bills.
example: 地方政府可用好专项再贷款支持清欠工作。

definition: The agreed period between delivery of goods/services and payment. Beijing is pushing industry-specific standardized payment terms to curb large-enterprise arrears to small suppliers.
example: 会议要求分行业明确合理账期。

definition: Founder and CEO of Unitree Robotics. Said in August 2026 that humanoid robots remain less efficient than human workers and must be retrained from scratch for each new task — framing generalization, not locomotion, as the industry's central unresolved problem.
significance: Founder and CEO of Unitree Robotics. Said in August 2026 that humanoid robots remain less efficient than human workers and must be retrained from scratch for each new task — framing generalization, not locomotion, as the industry's central unresolved problem.

definition: In-house silicon designed by a device maker rather than sourced from merchant chip vendors like Qualcomm or MediaTek. Xiaomi's Xring O3 (launched Aug 24, 2026) and XPeng's Turing chip are examples of the strategy.

An investor participating in a funding round for commercial or ecosystem reasons rather than purely financial return — often a corporate partner or rival, as with Tencent and Alibaba both backing XPeng Robotics' Aug 2026 round.
XPeng's humanoid robot platform. Its parent robotics division raised $900M+ at a $6.3B post-money valuation on Aug 24, 2026 — the largest single private financing yet in China's embodied-AI sector.
Local-government debt earmarked for specific infrastructure or investment projects, distinct from general-purpose fiscal borrowing. A recurring tool in China's fiscal-stimulus toolkit.

Vice Minister of Finance. Said at an Aug 22, 2026 Beijing briefing that new coordinated fiscal-and-financial policies for H2 2026 are still being drafted, underscoring the lag between policy announcement and deployment.
significance: Disclosed the delayed rollout of the ¥800B policy financing tool and confirmed H2 2026 fiscal-financial coordination policy is still in drafting, not yet launched.

definition: A company issuing new shares to raise additional capital after its IPO. Alibaba priced a HK$80B ($10.2B) placement on Aug 24, 2026 to fund AI infrastructure.
example: 阿里巴巴增发股票为AI基础设施建设融资。

definition: The reduction in existing shareholders' proportional ownership caused by the issuance of new shares.
example: 本次增发对现有股东造成约3.7%的股权稀释。

definition: China's top legislative body between full National People's Congress sessions, which reviews and passes most national laws.
example: 全国人大常委会审议了企业破产法修订草案。

definition: China's corporate insolvency statute, undergoing its first comprehensive revision since 2006 as of the Aug 2026 NPC Standing Committee session.
example: 企业破产法修订草案已提交二审。

definition: Tsinghua-spinout startup building prediction-based 'world models' for embodied AI, backed by Temasek.
example: 千寻智能获得淡马锡投资，押注世界模型路线。
